bullets.text: In Pallikaranai, a man died and his colleague is critical after falling into a septic tank from toxic fumes, and the office should monitor medical relief.
In Ambattur, a younger brother stabbed his older brother to death over allegations of misbehavior with his daughter and surrendered to the police.
A 55-year-old woman reported missing four days ago was found dead in a room at the Mylapore MRTS railway station by authorities.
PMK president Anbumani Ramadoss criticized the Tamil Nadu government over delays in notifying the Pallikaranai marshland as a wetland, which the office should watch.
The Velachery Residents Welfare Association hosted a Thanksgiving lunch to honor sanitation workers for maintaining neighborhood hygiene and cleanliness.
Environmental groups like Poovulagin Nanbargal condemned the government regarding Pallikaranai, and the office should track these environmental concerns.
In Avadi, friends cheated people out of 6 crore rupees through online trading training scams and were arrested by local police.
A worker died near Gummidipoondi when chemical powder leaked from boxes while being loaded onto a lorry, requiring office safety oversight.
Public commuters expressed distress over improper bus services on the Ponneri-Red Hills-Pulicat route, which the transport team should address.
A car plunged into a sinkhole on Old Mahabalipuram Road near Tidel Park after a road collapse without reported injuries.
Adani Enterprises and Jabil signed a pact for a 50:50 AI hardware joint venture in India to manufacture data center infrastructure.
A new tool was released to help companies test the safety and reliability of artificial intelligence platforms operating without human intervention.
Chief Minister C. Joseph Vijay will lay the foundation stone for a 3,108.55 crore rupee Chennai ring main pipeline project at Sholinganallur.
